sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: On a release tracklist with the "mb. INLINE STUFF" userscript installed, a track whose name differs from its recording's name (e.g. "The Rising (live 2002 MTV VMA performance)", "Lonesome Day (music video)") was invisible to everything that reads titles: its extra title information was not recognized or shown in green italics, it got no title warning, and the 📊 "Title info" sections skipped it. INLINE STUFF rewrites such a track link without MusicBrainz's inner name element, and ShowAllEntityData only looked for that element.
